newsitem.title: USA: USDA cancels marketing order for Georgia peaches.
newsitem.headline: USDA cancels marketing order for Georgia peaches.

text.p: The 55-year-old marketing order for Georgia peaches will end on September 17 and no one apparently will miss it, the Agriculture Department said Friday.

Provisions of the order, which detailed the size, grade and maturity of peaches shipped to the retail market, were suspended in 1993. The department announced on June 4 that it intended to terminate the order. No comments were received in response.
In a statement Friday, the department said the marketing order did not reflect current industry structure and there was no support for reactivation of it.

"If the Georgia peach industry expresses interest in a future marketing order, USDA would work with its representatives to develop one benefitting growers, handlers and consumers," said Lon Hatamiya, head of the Agricultural Marketing Service.
The marketing order was established in 1942 at the initiative of the Georgia peach industry.
